source.note: Sanskrit text based on Ambuda’s CC0 electronic edition of the 1910 Sri Vani Vilas Press text. Verse 16 follows the reading साक्ष्यस्मि in the Wikisource transcription. English translation and word-for-word gloss prepared for this edition.
source.changes: This text has no traditional chapter divisions in the cited edition, so its contents navigation now uses three descriptive ranges for the Self, the witness, and nondual knowledge.

units.label: Verse 1
units.deva:
सकृच्छ्रवणमात्रेण ब्रह्मज्ञानं यतो भवेत् ।
ब्रह्मज्ञानावलीमाला सर्वेषां मोक्षसिद्धये ॥१॥
units.translation: By hearing this just once, knowledge of Brahman may arise. This Garland of Brahman-Knowledge is for the liberation of all.

gloss.en: garland of the series of Brahman-knowledge

units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā
units.iast:
sakṛcchravaṇamātreṇa brahmajñānaṃ yato bhavet |
brahmajñānāvalīmālā sarveṣāṃ mokṣasiddhaye ||1||

units.label: Verse 2
units.translation: I am unattached, unattached, unattached—again and again. I am of the nature of being, consciousness, and bliss. I alone am; I am imperishable.

gloss.en: I am of the nature of being, consciousness, and bliss
I alone am; I am imperishable

units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā

units.label: Verse 3
units.translation: I am ever pure and free, formless, and imperishable. My nature is boundless bliss. I alone am; I am imperishable.

gloss.en: I am ever pure and free
I am of the nature of boundless bliss
I alone am; I am imperishable

units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā

units.label: Verse 4
units.translation: I am eternal, faultless, formless, and unchanging. My nature is supreme bliss. I alone am; I am imperishable.

gloss.en: I am of the nature of supreme bliss
I alone am; I am imperishable

units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā

units.label: Verse 5
units.translation: I am of the nature of pure consciousness, delighting in the Self. My nature is undivided bliss. I alone am; I am imperishable.

gloss.en: I am of the nature of pure consciousness
one who delights in the Self
of the nature of unbroken bliss
I alone am; I am imperishable

units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā

units.label: Verse 6
units.translation: I am inward consciousness, peaceful, and beyond primordial nature. My nature is eternal bliss. I alone am; I am imperishable.

gloss.en: I am of the nature of inward consciousness
I am of the nature of eternal bliss
I alone am; I am imperishable

units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā

units.label: Verse 7
units.deva:
तत्त्वातीतः परात्माहं मध्यातीतः परः शिवः ।
मायातीतः परंज्योतिरहमेवाहमव्ययः ॥७॥
units.translation: I am beyond all principles, the supreme Self; I am beyond the middle, the supreme Śiva. Beyond māyā, I am the highest light. I alone am; I am imperishable.

gloss.en: beyond the middle; beyond the intermediate
the supreme Śiva, the auspicious one
I alone am; I am imperishable

units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā
units.iast:
tattvātītaḥ parātmāhaṃ madhyātītaḥ paraḥ śivaḥ |
māyātītaḥ paraṃjyotirahamevāhamavyayaḥ ||7||

units.label: Verse 8
units.translation: I am beyond manifold forms, consciousness itself, and unchanging. My very nature is happiness. I alone am; I am imperishable.

gloss.en: I am of the form of consciousness
I alone am; I am imperishable

units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā

units.label: Verse 9
units.translation: Māyā, its effects, the body, and the rest are never mine. I am of one self-luminous nature. I alone am; I am imperishable.

gloss.en: I am of one self-luminous nature
I alone am; I am imperishable

units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā

units.label: Verse 10
units.translation: I am beyond the three guṇas and the witness of Brahmā and the others. I am endless and of infinite forms. I alone am; I am imperishable.

gloss.en: I am beyond the three guṇas
of Brahmā and the others too
I am endless, of infinite forms
I alone am; I am imperishable

units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā

units.label: Verse 11
units.translation: I am the inner ruler, immutable, and all-pervading. My nature is the supreme Self. I alone am; I am imperishable.

gloss.en: I am of the nature of the inner ruler
of the nature of the supreme Self
I alone am; I am imperishable

units.sectionTitle: Verses 11–16 · The changeless witness beyond bodies and states

units.label: Verse 12
units.translation: I am partless and actionless, the primordial and eternal Self of all. My nature is immediate and directly present. I alone am; I am imperishable.

gloss.en: of an immediate, directly present nature
I alone am; I am imperishable

units.sectionTitle: Verses 11–16 · The changeless witness beyond bodies and states

units.label: Verse 13
units.translation: I am the witness of opposites and the rest, unmoving and eternal. I am the witness of all. I alone am; I am imperishable.

gloss.en: I am the witness of opposites and the rest
of the nature of the witness of all
I alone am; I am imperishable

units.sectionTitle: Verses 11–16 · The changeless witness beyond bodies and states

units.label: Verse 14
units.deva:
प्रज्ञानघन एवाहं विज्ञानघन एव च ।
अकर्ताहमभोक्ताहमहमेवाहमव्ययः ॥१४॥
units.translation: I am awareness in its entirety, knowledge in its entirety. I do not act or experience. I alone am; I am imperishable.

gloss.en: I am indeed a whole of awareness
and indeed a whole of knowledge
I am not an agent; I do not act
I alone am; I am imperishable

units.sectionTitle: Verses 11–16 · The changeless witness beyond bodies and states
units.iast:
prajñānaghana evāhaṃ vijñānaghana eva ca |
akartāhamabhoktāhamahamevāhamavyayaḥ ||14||

units.label: Verse 15
units.translation: I am without support, yet I alone support all. My nature is fulfilled desire: I lack nothing. I alone am; I am imperishable.

gloss.en: I am of a nature without support
of the nature of one whose desires are fulfilled
I alone am; I am imperishable

units.sectionTitle: Verses 11–16 · The changeless witness beyond bodies and states

units.label: Verse 16
units.translation: Free from the threefold affliction and distinct from the three bodies, I am the witness of the three states. I alone am; I am imperishable.

gloss.en: I am the witness of the three states
and I alone am; I am imperishable

units.sectionTitle: Verses 11–16 · The changeless witness beyond bodies and states

units.label: Verse 17
units.deva:
दृग्दृश्यौ द्वौ पदार्थौ स्तः परस्परविलक्षणौ ।
दृग्ब्रह्म दृश्यं मायेति सर्ववेदान्तडिण्डिमः ॥१७॥
units.translation: The seer and the seen are two entities, distinct from each other. The seer is Brahman; the seen is māyā—so proclaims all Vedānta.

gloss.en: the proclamation of all Vedānta (the Vedānta drumbeat)

units.sectionTitle: Verses 17–21 · Discrimination, nonduality, and the light of the Self
units.iast:
dṛgdṛśyau dvau padārthau staḥ parasparavilakṣaṇau |
dṛgbrahma dṛśyaṃ māyeti sarvavedāntaḍiṇḍimaḥ ||17||

units.label: Verse 18
units.deva:
अहं साक्षीति यो विद्याद्विविच्यैवं पुनः पुनः ।
स एव मुक्तः सो विद्वानिति वेदान्तडिण्डिमः ॥१८॥
units.translation: Whoever repeatedly discerns, “I am the witness,” is liberated; that one is the knower, so proclaims Vedānta.

gloss.en: that one is the knower, thus

units.sectionTitle: Verses 17–21 · Discrimination, nonduality, and the light of the Self
units.iast:
ahaṃ sākṣīti yo vidyādvivicyaivaṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
sa eva muktaḥ so vidvāniti vedāntaḍiṇḍimaḥ ||18||

units.label: Verse 19
units.deva:
घटकुड्यादिकं सर्वं मृत्तिकामात्रमेव च ।
तद्वद्ब्रह्म जगत्सर्वमिति वेदान्तडिण्डिमः ॥१९॥
units.translation: Pots, walls, and the like are all only clay. In the same way, the whole world is Brahman, so proclaims Vedānta.
units.sectionTitle: Verses 17–21 · Discrimination, nonduality, and the light of the Self
units.iast:
ghaṭakuḍyādikaṃ sarvaṃ mṛttikāmātrameva ca |
tadvadbrahma jagatsarvamiti vedāntaḍiṇḍimaḥ ||19||

units.label: Verse 20
units.deva:
ब्रह्म सत्यं जगन्मिथ्या जीवो ब्रह्मैव नापरः ।
अनेन वेद्यं सच्छास्त्रमिति वेदान्तडिण्डिमः ॥२०॥
units.translation: Brahman is real; the world is mithyā, dependent and not ultimately real; the individual self is Brahman alone, with no second. This is the true teaching to be known, so proclaims Vedānta.

gloss.en: is dependent and not ultimately real

units.sectionTitle: Verses 17–21 · Discrimination, nonduality, and the light of the Self
units.iast:
brahma satyaṃ jaganmithyā jīvo brahmaiva nāparaḥ |
anena vedyaṃ sacchāstramiti vedāntaḍiṇḍimaḥ ||20||

units.label: Verse 21
units.deva:
अन्तर्ज्योतिर्बहिर्ज्योतिः प्रत्यग्ज्योतिः परात्परः ।
ज्योतिर्ज्योतिः स्वयंज्योतिरात्मज्योतिः शिवोऽस्म्यहम् ॥२१॥
units.translation: I am Śiva: the light within, the light without, the inward light, beyond the highest; the light of lights, self-luminous, the light of the Self.
units.sectionTitle: Verses 17–21 · Discrimination, nonduality, and the light of the Self
units.iast:
antarjyotirbahirjyotiḥ pratyagjyotiḥ parātparaḥ |
jyotirjyotiḥ svayaṃjyotirātmajyotiḥ śivo’smyaham ||21||
